text:
Anya (Marketing): Hey design — we need a quick pack for launch: compact 'inference economics' micro-tiles (3 size variants) + a webinar registration hero card. Timeline EOD Tue. Can you take this?
Sam P.: On it. Quick q: do tiles need cost-per-1000 tokens vs latency or a single combined metric?
Anya (Marketing): Need both: separate tiles for latency, unit-cost, and relative throughput. Also a combined 'quick takeaway' tile. Use brand palette, keep text <30 chars per tile.
Devin - Design: Adding asset list so we don't miss anything — SVG master for each tile, PNG exports @2x (320x180, 480x270, 640x360), Figma file with components, alt-text snippets, and a CSV with the numbers. For the webinar reg card: 1200x628 hero + 600x315 social, 3 CTA variants (Register, Save my spot, Learn more).
Marta - Brand: Brand check: No hero images of people. Use brand gradients, maintain 16px min type size, use Redwood Sans for headings. I'll do a quick brand pass after comps land.
Sam P.: Uploading initial comps in ~4h. Also need canonical copy for tiles — Anya, can you paste final numbers and one-line takeaways here so we don't iterate later?
Anya (Marketing): Numbers here: Latency — 35ms (avg); Throughput — 120 req/s; Cost — $0.0018/token (est). Takeaways: 'Low-latency, low-cost serving' and 'Optimize costs with batching.'
LaunchBot: :bell: Automated reminder — assets pack deadline in 48h for #marketing.
Devin - Design: Proposed filename conventions in Figma and exports: econ-tile_latency.svg, econ-tile_throughput.svg, econ-tile_cost.svg, econ-tile_combined.svg, webinar_reg_hero_v1.png. Adding ARIA alt text in a Figma note per asset.
Sam P.: Design question — for the combined tile, should we show a tiny sparkline + three micro-bars, or keep it icon + numbers? Tiny sparkline is quicker to read.
Anya (Marketing): :thumbsup: sparkline ok. Keep color usage accessible — Marta will run contrast check.
Marta - Brand: I'll run contrast and brand rules after Sam uploads. Also add legal small-print placeholder: 'Estimates based on internal tests; results may vary.'
Sam P.: Uploading comps now: https://figma.com/file/abc123/compact-econ-pack — ping me when you review and I'll iterate.
Devin - Design: I'll prep the export zip for inbound team and include a minimal README with filenames, sizes, and suggested copy hooks for social. Anyone want alt text drafts posted here?
Anya (Marketing): Please include alt text. Quick draft for combined tile: 'Tile showing average latency 35ms, throughput 120 req/s and estimated unit cost $0.0018/token; mini sparkline indicates steady latency.'
Marta - Brand: Approved pending contrast fixes and switching the secondary accent to the accessible-blue token in the style guide.
Anya (Marketing): Thanks everyone — once Sam uploads final PNGs/SVGs, I'll route the pack to demand-gen and webinar ops. We'll store final zip at /marketing/launchs/pack_2024-05. Closing thread after upload.
